values.note: City of Fremont: $25 a night, paid by envelope at the drop-box (cash or check) or at the Parks and Recreation Office; a $10 late charge if not registered within an hour. A camper paid $25 in June 2026.

fees.source: https://fremontne.gov/931/Camping ('The fee is $25 per night – follow instructions on payment envelope at drop-box'; 'A $10 late charge will be added for late registration'; 'Cash & check accepted at campground, cash / check / card accepted at Parks and Recreation Office'), read 2026-11-05; RV Life review 6/2026 '$25 USD' dates it

hookups.source: https://fremontne.gov/931/Camping ('The West Campground has 26; 30 amp, 26; 50 amp open for the public'), read 2026-11-05; the page is silent on water at the sites (stored water true rests on the old note)

sites.source: https://fremontne.gov/931/Camping ('The West Campground has 26; 30 amp, 26; 50 amp open for the public. The East Campground has 20 pedestals, all 30 amp designated for only special events'), read 2026-11-05

values.note: Opens between April 1 and Memorial Day, with the first scheduled special event; the Nov 1 closing is subject to weather.

season.source: https://fremontne.gov/931/Camping ('Campground Closed November 1 st. *Subject to change based on weather* Campgrounds will open between April 1st - Memorial Day dependent on first scheduled special event.'), read 2026-11-05

values.note: Register within an hour of taking a site, and by 4 pm each day unless the whole stay is paid in advance. 14 consecutive days per calendar year; longer needs the Parks and Recreation Office's approval (402-727-2634). Sites are held for scheduled events, so campers may have to move or leave.

booking.source: https://fremontne.gov/931/Camping ('Camping is first come, first served -- no reservations accepted'; 'Campers must register within one hour of occupying the site'; 'All campers must pre-register for the day by 4pm unless you have paid for your entire stay in advance'; 'Camping is limited to 14 consecutive days per calendar year'; 'Camping spots are reserved for those participating in current scheduled events, you may have to move or leave the campground depending on the event'), read 2026-11-05

note: City of Fremont campground at the Christensen Field complex, outside the Main Arena. The West Campground is open to the public; the East Campground's 20 pedestals are for special events only. Campers may have to move or leave for a scheduled event. No tents. --Claude
summary: City page confirms $25/night by drop-box, first come, 52 public sites (26 x 30 A, 26 x 50 A) in the West Campground, 14-day limit, closes Nov 1, opens April-Memorial Day with the first event; a June 2026 camper paid $25 for an ordinary overnight. Inclusion passes with a caveat (sites held for events). Not waterfront stands. Pin OK.
flags: INCLUSION passes with a caveat (fair/expo-ground rule): the page sells ordinary nights to the public ('The West Campground has 26; 30 amp, 26; 50 amp open for the public'; 'The fee is $25 per night'), separate from the event-only East Campground, and an RV Life camper (6/2026, travel trailer, $25) stayed an ordinary overnight. But 'Camping spots are reserved for those participating in current scheduled events, you may have to move or leave the campground depending on the event', and opening is tied to events ('Campgrounds will open between April 1st - Memorial Day dependent on first scheduled special event'). Kept in the note and booking.note; AWH may judge whether being bumped for events matters.
SITE COUNT added: 52 (26 x 30 A + 26 x 50 A, West Campground, public); the East Campground's 20 event-only pedestals not counted.

PIN OK (with a doubt): stored 41.44480,-96.52320 is on the gravel lot just west of the main arena building, where Esri shows RVs. A long gravel strip with pedestal posts at ~25 m spacing runs north-south ~190-230 m further west (~41.4455,-96.5255) beside the soccer fields; either could be the West Campground. Both are within 250 m, so no move.
WATERFRONT not waterfront stands: no water near the complex (ball fields, arena, cemetery).
PHONE: stored 402-727-2630 is the City of Fremont main line; the page gives the Parks and Recreation Office as 402-727-2634, the better number for camping. apply.py doesn't write phone.

NOTE CLEANED: dropped the 30/50-amp site counts (hookups, sites.count), 'level pull-through gravel pads with water; year-round trailer dump station' (sites/hookups/facilities), 'Fits large rigs (sites listed to ~50 ft)' (sites.max_rig_ft), 'FCFS, no reservations; $25/night; 14-day limit' (booking, fees) and 'Open roughly April through Nov 1, closed winter' (season). Added nothing a field holds; kept the setting and the event caveat.
